findings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six current pose renders confirms the sharply faceted bell silhouette, irregular pleats and jagged underside. Crouch still lifts and opens the front/side panels away from the thighs; sit lap coverage remains incomplete. V178 changed authored left/right assignment on 1439/1293 exclusive front-lap vertices. Sit records 5/266 same-side hits per lap, 5/266 left-lap-to-right-thigh and 6/266 right-lap-to-left-thigh hits, with only 1/266 same-side samples per lap within the diagnostic-only 30 mm; deduplicated union is 21/532. Crouch remains cross-side dominant (29/266 and 36/266 versus 20/266 and 19/266 same-side). This geometry diagnostic does not establish fit tolerance.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in the current front and posed views. Their cause is not established by the renders; visible surface quality remains unacceptable and requires a separate measured diagnosis.
